comment: Negative-case test vectors for VectorPin protocol v2. Each entry's `expected_failure` matches one of the v2 VerifyError codes from spec §5.

fixtures.name: tampered_vector
fixtures.description: The vector bytes have been modified after pinning.

fixtures.name: tampered_source
fixtures.description: The caller supplies a source string that does not match the pin's source_hash.

fixtures.name: wrong_expected_model
fixtures.description: Caller asks the verifier to enforce a model name that does not match.

fixtures.name: wrong_vec_dim_breaks_signature
fixtures.description: vec_dim is part of the signed canonical bytes; changing it breaks the ed25519 signature verification (not a SHAPE_MISMATCH because the verifier reaches signature check first).

fixtures.name: wrong_version
fixtures.description: Pin with v=99; strict v2 verifier rejects before signature check.

fixtures.name: wrong_kid_unknown_key
fixtures.description: Pin's kid is not in the verifier's registry. UNKNOWN_KEY fires before signature check per spec §5 step 2.

fixtures.name: sig_bit_flipped
fixtures.description: One bit of the signature has been flipped; ed25519 rejects.

fixtures.name: sig_wrong_length
fixtures.description: Signature decodes to 32 bytes; parser rejects before crypto.

fixtures.name: unknown_top_level_field
fixtures.description: Pin contains a top-level field outside the v2 allowed set.

fixtures.name: non_string_extra_value
fixtures.description: extra map contains a value that is not a string.

fixtures.name: nan_in_vector_at_verify
fixtures.description: Caller supplies a vector containing NaN. Verifier rejects before hashing per spec §5 step 6.

fixtures.name: nfd_model_string
fixtures.description: model field is in NFD form ('café' as e + COMBINING ACUTE), not NFC. Parser rejects per spec §3.1.

fixtures.name: ts_fractional_seconds
fixtures.description: Timestamp has fractional seconds; strict regex rejects.

fixtures.name: ts_with_offset
fixtures.description: Timestamp has an explicit offset instead of trailing Z.

fixtures.name: ts_lowercase_tz
fixtures.description: Timestamp uses lowercase t/z separators; strict regex rejects.

fixtures.name: record_id_mismatch
fixtures.description: Pin commits to vectorpin.record_id=rec-real but the caller asks the verifier to enforce rec-other.

fixtures.name: oversize_pin_json
fixtures.description: Pin JSON exceeds the §4.3 64 KiB cap; rejected pre-parse.

fixtures.name: widened_f64_low_bit_perturbation
fixtures.description: f64 vector supplied against an f32 pin; every element's low 28 mantissa bits differ from the signed values while the f32 rounding is unchanged. Verifiers MUST refuse the wider representation (SHAPE_MISMATCH) rather than cast and accept.

fixtures.name: widened_f64_exact_values
fixtures.description: f64 vector holding exactly the signed f32 values, supplied against an f32 pin. Still SHAPE_MISMATCH: widening is refused regardless of the values.

fixtures.name: shape_mismatch_truncated_vector
fixtures.description: Supplied vector has 8 elements; the pin commits to 16.

fixtures.name: sig_padded_base64
fixtures.description: sig carries '=' padding; §2 requires URL-safe base64 without padding.

fixtures.name: sig_noncanonical_trailing_bits
fixtures.description: sig's final base64url symbol sets padding bits that must be zero; the string is not the canonical encoding of any 64-byte value.

fixtures.name: ts_day_zero
fixtures.description: ts '2026-03-00T12:00:00Z' matches the digit pattern but is not a real UTC instant; every port rejects it at parse time instead of rolling it into a different date.

fixtures.name: ts_month_13
fixtures.description: ts '2026-13-05T12:00:00Z' matches the digit pattern but is not a real UTC instant; every port rejects it at parse time instead of rolling it into a different date.

fixtures.name: ts_february_30
fixtures.description: ts '2026-02-30T12:00:00Z' matches the digit pattern but is not a real UTC instant; every port rejects it at parse time instead of rolling it into a different date.

fixtures.name: ts_hour_24
fixtures.description: ts '2026-05-05T24:00:00Z' matches the digit pattern but is not a real UTC instant; every port rejects it at parse time instead of rolling it into a different date.

fixtures.name: lone_surrogate_in_model
fixtures.description: model contains a lone UTF-16 surrogate (escaped as \ud800 in the JSON). It has no UTF-8 encoding and therefore no canonical bytes; parsers MUST reject it rather than crash or substitute U+FFFD.

fixtures.name: v_non_integer_literal
fixtures.description: v is the JSON number 2.0; §4.1 requires an integer.

fixtures.name: extra_null
fixtures.description: extra is JSON null; §4.1 allows only an object or absence.

fixtures.name: model_exceeds_field_cap
fixtures.description: model is 2000 bytes; §4.3 caps model at 1024 bytes.

fixtures.name: kid_exceeds_field_cap
fixtures.description: kid is 300 bytes; §4.3 caps kid at 256 bytes.

fixtures.name: model_hash_mismatch
fixtures.description: Pin commits to one model_hash; the caller expects another.

fixtures.name: model_hash_missing_when_expected
fixtures.description: Pin has no model_hash but the caller requires one.

fixtures.name: collection_id_mismatch
fixtures.description: Pin commits to vectorpin.collection_id=col-A; caller expects col-B.

fixtures.name: tenant_id_mismatch
fixtures.description: Pin commits to vectorpin.tenant_id=ten-1; caller expects ten-2.

fixtures.name: key_expired_ts_after_valid_until
fixtures.description: Registry entry has valid_until=2026-01-01; the pin's ts is 2026-05-05, so the key was already retired.

fixtures.name: key_expired_backdated_ts_with_trusted_time
fixtures.description: Registry entry has valid_until=2026-06-01 and the pin's ts (2026-05-05) sits inside the window, but the caller supplies a trusted ingestion time of 2026-07-01: the window is evaluated against the trusted clock, so a backdated pin is rejected.
